reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Added support headers and timeout configurations of gRPC requests when exporting traces to OpenTelemetry Collector", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: This is a new feature addition with no impact on existing deployments. Operators may optionally configure headers and timeouts for gRPC trace exports to OpenTelemetry Collector.

proposed.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds support for headers and timeout configurations of gRPC requests when exporting traces to OpenTelemetry Collector.
